dialog: Hey there. Whatcha up to?
Coming after me? You're cruising for a cursing!
You should have been more careful!
This is what happens if you don't just run away!
Bringing disaster on yourself?\nNot very smart.
Looks like it's my turn now!
Wanna see a REAL god's power?
Go easy on you? That'd be silly!
Better wake up/ or the disaster will catch ya!
This really isn't much. I'm sure you can handle it.
I'm throwing a danmaku festival/ and you'd better have a good time!
Think you've got me cornered/ do you?
Well/ isn't this getting interesting!
This is just what happens if you don't give up your grudges.
Time to knock you off your high horse!
Gotcha!
This is my Mythical Ring!
And here we go!
Take this!
Think you can slip your way past this one?
This is where things REALLY get started.
Now dance for me!
Always begin with a greeting!
Heh heh heh. It's been a while/ so rampage to your heart's content!
Crush them underfoot!
Clobber them to pieces!
The longest arms and legs you've ever seen!
They're adorable/ aren't they?
Yeah! Keep at it!
You can try to run/ but it's a little too late for that!
I'll just catch you...
...and give you a nice smack or two!
This is the power of a native god!
Well/ now you've got a front row seat!
It's not over yet!
I'll make an exception to assist you.
Excuse me? Nobody asked.
I'll hold them down with ivy.
Hey! Quit it already!
Why don't you ever listen/ Kanako?!
Don't tell me you've forgotten what happened back then.
Of course not.
I caused the wisteria vines to grow...
...and I sliced 'em down with my iron rings!
Which means I won!
Wait. That one's mine.
Hey/ lay off!
I told you to go somewhere else!
Oh/ come on!
Humans have feared countless gods since ancient times...
...and I'll show you them all!
What? You're happy you get to go nuts after so long?
I think that's something we can all agree on!
Wake up/ wake up! It's time for a cursing!
Sic 'em!
No need to rush/ right?
I think this calls for a wait-and-see approach.
You seem skilled/ but not really FUN at all/ you know?
Ugh. Are you serious?
That one's in for a terrible curse.
Have a curse too/ while you're at it!
Time to steal the spotlight!
You're being too slow about this!
That's the one we're after/ right?
I'm on the job!
I'll hop—er/ help you right out!
I'll think about how you can repay me.
I can't exactly abandon you/ can I?
Oh/ what am I going to do with you?
Want to see how a god does her fighting?
I'll go first!
I guess we have the same target!
Great! Get 'em!
Hey/ let me in on the fun too!
Time to steal the spotlight!
Another divine boon/ coming your way!
I want to have as much fun as I can!
Come one/ come all! This is divine entertainment at its best!
No leaving a god behind!
Anyone who messes with Momiji has a curse waiting for them.
I'm grabbing the fun part/ Momiji!
Handle the rest for me/ Momiji!
Underestimate the mountain's youkai at your own peril!
Oh/ Momiji. What am I going to do with you?
Just another blessing for the mountain's youkai!
Pull it together/ Momiji!
Get 'em/ Momiji!
Let me in on the fun/ Momiji!
With me/ Momiji!
Go find me the best opponent here/ Momiji!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Momiji and me!
Momiji/ let's have all the fun we can handle!
Anyone who messes with Aya has a curse waiting for them.
I'm grabbing the fun part/ Aya!
Handle the rest for me/ Aya!
Underestimate the mountain's youkai at your own peril!
Oh/ Aya. What am I going to do with you?
Just another blessing for the mountain's youkai!
Pull it together/ Aya!
Get 'em/ Aya!
Let me in on the fun/ Aya!
With me/ Aya!
Go find me the best opponent here/ Momiji!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Aya and me!
Aya/ let's have all the fun we can handle!
Anyone who messes with Hatate has a curse waiting for them.
I'm grabbing the fun part/ Hatate!
Handle the rest for me/ Hatate!
Underestimate the mountain's youkai at your own peril!
Oh/ Hatate. What am I going to do with you?
Just another blessing for the mountain's youkai!
Pull it together/ Hatate!
Get 'em/ Hatate!
Let me in on the fun/ Hatate!
With me/ Hatate!
Go find me the best opponent here/ Hatate!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Hatate and me!
Hatate/ let's have all the fun we can handle!
Ugh/ you always get too far out in front...
Hey! Kanako/ you didn't finish this one off!
That one's mine/ Kanako.
I'd rather you be the one protecting me.
Protecting Kanako? What's Gensokyo coming to...
Kanako's prey is my prey!
No fair! I want in on the fun too/ Kanako!
The heavens and the earth alike are with us!
Get 'em/ Kanako!
Kanako/ you know what to do!
Don't leave me behind/ Kanako!
Let me in on the fun/ Kanako!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Kanako and me!
Wow. How could I let this happen?
You're not pulling your punches/ are you/ Sanae?
Sanae/ you have to make sure you finish them off!
I guess you're still inexperienced/ huh?
You're not laying a hand on our Sanae!
Look out/ Sanae! They're after you!
Keep your head in the game/ Sanae!
Show them how you fight/ Sanae!
Let's go/ Sanae!
I'll give you an example of how a god fights!
I wanna see your training in action/ Sanae!
Let me in on the fun/ Sanae!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Sanae and me!
Don't leave me behind/ Sanae!
Anyone who bullies Okuu has a curse waiting for them.
Allow me/ Okuu! This is the fun part!
This is how you REALLY use a god's power!
You're so easily distracted/ Okuu.
Oh/ Okuu. What are we going to do with you?
I'll be watching/ Okuu.
Go crazy/ Okuu.
Get 'em/ Okuu!
Let me in on the fun/ Okuu!
With me/ Okuu!
Show them how you can shine/ Okuu!
Time for a danmaku festival/ courtesy of Okuu and me!
Okuu/ let's have all the fun we can handle!
I can pretty much tell how your bullets will move.
Just like I planned.
Now THIS is danmaku! You can keep going if you want.
It's gonna take a lot more than that/ bub!
Oh/ drat/ I got hit?
It'll take more than a bunch of puny attacks like that to beat me.
You hit me? I'm so proud.
Nice/ nice! A little more/ and you'll beat me.
Ouch! You're one tough customer.
Huh. Guess you're not afraid of curses.
Wow/ I haven't felt like I was on the back foot in a long time!
Would you quit struggling already?!
Nice attack you've got there!
Whoops/ that one spooked me.
Wait. That hit me?
Oww! I thought I dodged that one...
This'll help me tough it out.
Anyone who touches this barrier gets bad luck!
Oof. That one really hurt...
Yeah/ yeah! Good stuff.
Holding back is only gonna get you hurt.
I feel like maybe you shouldn't be reckless...
Aaa uuu...
Owies!
Your mistake was going after me!
Whatcha got for me next?
Welp/ that was easy.
You're not holding back/ are you?
Well/ that's a letdown.
Wow/ you thought that would hit me/ huh?
Now THIS is danmaku! You can keep going if you want.
Yeah! This is how games like these are supposed to go!
Just a little graze/ that's all.
Whoosh!
Is that the best you can manage?
C'mon! Don't let the fun end!
Did you think you hit me? What a shame!
Aw/ so close! You were just a frog's hair away.
Heh heh. Maybe this'll be some good exercise.
If that's all you've got/ then you'll never even touch me.
This is the overflowing power of a native god!
If you're done/ then it's my turn!
Heh heh. Now how will I handle this?
Oww... Looks like I lost/ huh?
Aaa uuu. You got me...
Guess I'll back out and plot...er/ I mean/ cheer you all on!
Welp/ that's a wrap. Didn't realize how strong they were!
Oww... Looks like I lost/ huh?
Ack! I let my guard down...
Man/ I was trying not to let them get me... I'll just watch the rest from the rear.
They're that strong? You all might want to pay attention to this!
Time to see if you're worthy of being Sanae's companion.
I want another look at the tengu's power!
Time to see if you're worthy of being Sanae's companion.
I want another look at the tengu's power!
Time to see if you're worthy of being Sanae's companion.
I want another look at the tengu's power!
C'mon/ Sanae. No need to hold back!
Show me the fruits of your training/ Sanae.
I always finish what I start!
Didn't think you were quite this good...
We have to do something to quell Yatagarasu's power!
Okuu/ it'll only be a little longer/ okay?
I'm still just fooling around!
You caused an incident? I can't exactly overlook that.
This is an awful way to go about things. I'll have to stop you.
Now you've REALLY got a curse god mad!
The way you do things is wrong. I won't let you have your way!
Vengeance for Hisoutensoku!
Never thought I'd see Hisoutensoku like this...
Yeesh. Didn't want to see you like this.
Wait/ you're ACTUALLY trying to tick off a curse god?
You're the one who needs to take a long dip in a dark abyss!
Oh hey. Looking a lot flashier now/ I see.
We'd never lose to some stupid nightmares!
Whoa/ that brings me back.
What a good opportunity to beat the frog snot out of you!
Hmm. I don't think you made me quite cute enough.
You'd think being in a dream would be more pleasant.
You're not getting your way any longer!
Give up and accept this curse!
The way you're doing things won't last forever!
Alright/ then! Show me this dream of yours!
Ugh. Now neither of us is having fun.
Time to dole out some divine punishment!
I'm still mad about Hisoutensoku/ you know!
Alright/ then! Show me this dream of yours!
This is going to be the last party—and the biggest!
Time to dole out some divine punishment!
I'm still mad about you ruining everything/ you know!
Alright/ then! Show me this dream of yours!
This is going to be the last party—and the biggest!
Hey/ no fair! Don't just talk to Kanako the whole time!
I'm joining in the fun with you/ Byakuren!
